title: What changed
tooLittle: Once you have at least three full months of entries, this shows what changed in the latest month compared with the ones before.
nothing: {month} looked like a usual month. Nothing stood out.
newPayeeWhy: Someone new: you had not paid them in the months before.
keptLess: Left over in {month}: {kept}, {difference} less than usual.
keptMore: Left over in {month}: {kept}, {difference} more than usual.
why_spendingUp: Spending was {spending} higher than usual, while income stayed about the same.
why_spendingDown: Spending was {spending} lower than usual, while income stayed about the same.
why_incomeUp: Income was {income} higher than usual, while spending stayed about the same.
why_incomeDown: Income was {income} lower than usual, while spending stayed about the same.
why_spendingUp_incomeUp: Spending was {spending} higher and income {income} higher than usual.
why_spendingUp_incomeDown: Spending was {spending} higher and income {income} lower than usual.
why_spendingDown_incomeUp: Spending was {spending} lower and income {income} higher than usual.
why_spendingDown_incomeDown: Spending was {spending} lower and income {income} lower than usual.
usualFrom: Usual is about {usual} a month: the average of {months}.
usualKeptFrom: Usual is about {usual}: the average of {months}.
weekPast: Your statements end on {date}, so this is the last week they cover.
weekUsual: About the same as a usual week ({usual}).
weekMore_one: That is {difference} more than a usual week ({usual}, the week before).
weekMore_other: That is {difference} more than a usual week ({usual}, the average of the {count} weeks before).
weekLess_one: That is {difference} less than a usual week ({usual}, the week before).
weekLess_other: That is {difference} less than a usual week ({usual}, the average of the {count} weeks before).
